“And give him no rest”: give God no rest, “till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth”: until the kingdom of heaven is established on earth.

sense.text:
But brother, I’m tired? Go sit down, catch a wind, then come back. We are engaged in active combat. Battle fatigue, combat stress: we all go through that, but don’t give up. Never give up, never give in. Keep pushing.

“But in a great house”: the nation of Israel, even amongst us right here. “There are not only vessels of gold”: amongst all of you men and women there are vessels of gold; some of you are gold. “And of silver”: some of you are vessels of silver in here. “But also of wood”: some of you is no damn good. Some of you are vessels of wood: those of you still hiding your sins, in the midst of adultery, lying, pedophiles on the side, liars and thieves. That’s the wood. “And of earth”: that’s you still no damn good. “And some to honour, and some to dishonour”: some of you are to honour and some of you are to dishonour in this truth.

I don’t look at things with rose colored glasses and say oh everybody’s perfect. Through years of experience I know some of you come into this truth no damn good; I read that in the Bible, so I know that. But some of you I know are gold and silver, and some of you are trying your best to be that gold and silver. You will struggle, you will strive, like we all do.

“If a man therefore purge himself from these”: these what? The wood and the earth, those vessels that are to dishonour. You men, you women, through conversation you’re going to know who’s gold, who’s silver, who’s wood and who’s earth. You ain’t going to know overnight, it’s going to take a little time, but you going to figure it out: this brother, this sister is no damn good, they always gossiping, always murmuring, and the conversation is always about sex or something stupid. When I came out I had to learn quick to get away from those: every time we go hang out we end up in some damn trouble. I got to stay away from these cats.

“He shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use”: good for Christ’s use, “and prepared unto every good work.” In order to be meet for the master’s use, prepared unto every good work, you got to separate yourself, purge yourself from these brothers and sisters that are dishonourable, who are in the midst of the works of the flesh. Leave them to themselves; let the Lord deal with them, let them fight and struggle. If you decide that’s your friend, when they go down you go down too.

“Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.” We are going to enter the kingdom through much tribulation. It is not going to be no rose garden.

Why go through much tribulation? To try us, to prove us, to test us, to see if we are worthy. That is the battle fatigue we all go through in this truth, and we have to continue in the faith through it.
“Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established”. We are carpenters, and our house is builded through wisdom. That is why we pray all you men acquire to yourselves wisdom.

“And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.” That is a wise master builder: being able to put brothers and sisters where they fit in. Who has what skill, what talent, what gift, what zeal, what level of faith. That is how the chambers of the house of Israel are filled.

“If I forget thee, O Jerusalem”: if I forget my identity as an Israelite. “Let my right hand forget her cunning”: let me forget how to live according to God’s laws. That is what David is saying in the spirit.

You might ask what this has to do with anything. It has a lot to do with us knowing that Jerusalem is our homeland. It identifies us as Israelites. So brothers and sisters from Haiti, if you get upset when we talk about Haiti, it is because you don’t have Jerusalem as your first love. If you get mad when we talk about Puerto Rico, it is because Jerusalem is not your love. You forgot Jerusalem, and you really cleave and hold on to these lands of captivity.

“If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth”: if I don’t remember my identity as an Israelite, let me speak wrong, let me teach wrong.

Our brothers and sisters in England had a fundraiser called Congo day. What about Jerusalem day? We are not to make up our own holidays or days of celebration. What if we said let’s have America day and wear the red, white and blue with fringes? Y’all would look at us crazy, and it’s the same thing: there is no difference between America day, Haiti day, Congo day, freaking Puerto Rico day or Santo Domingo day. What the hell is going on here? This happens when you don’t seek counsel, when you start doing things on your own thinking it’s harmless. Later on somebody will say I want a Puerto Rico day, a Mexico day, an Ecuador day, because they did it over there. It still goes against what the scriptures want: to lead our people to Jerusalem, to the promised land, to the kingdom, to the truth that they are Israelites. Don’t put a twist on it.

In the old school, a brother came in whose wife was very pretty, and one of the senior men said that woman is so fine you’re not worthy of her, and took his wife and gave her to a higher ranking officer. That is freaking adultery. At another school they had something called Salsa day, with a disco ball. Raising hell about it got me told I did not have the love of Jesus, but it led somewhere: months go by and it led to the fringes going from one size to the next, to no fringes at all, to eating pork, and then everybody just breaking the Sabbath day. Don’t say this could never happen in IUIC.

“What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.”

In Dallas a married couple started to get into fist fights; the wife put the husband in the full nelson. They divorced, and the husband remarried another sister, one he liked better. She was already married. What is that called? It is adultery, and the scripture for it is here.
They asked why Moses commanded to give a writing of divorcement, and he said “Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.”

Verse 9 is the point. “Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication”: that is the one reason you can put away your wife, brothers. “And shall marry another”: you choose another woman to marry, that “committeth adultery”. “And whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.” That’s the law.

So we ooh and ah about what happened in the old school, but some of that is still going on today. Wherever it happened, it makes no difference: it is still adultery.

We got a plethora of phone calls and emails about New York City on New Year’s Eve: at midnight there was screaming and partying, get down, boogie, shake it, drop it like it’s hot. The Bible says “Abstain from all appearance of evil.”

I could say I know y’all wasn’t celebrating New Year’s Eve, but to the world and to new spirits it looks like it. They go, nah, you trying to be slick, y’all are celebrating it.

Paul is talking about eating foods offered to idols, but it shows us something. “If any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol’s temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols”. A new brother comes in, just came out of that life. You told him idols were wicked, but now you’re in the idol’s temple eating the food, and he’s watching you.

“And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died”. His conscience is messed up, because with all your knowledge you taught him or her idols are evil, and now you’re eating food offered to idols while he watches.

“But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.” You sin by setting a bad example. I don’t celebrate New Year’s Eve, you told me it was evil, it was wicked, but here it is midnight, I cut on the TV and you are partying, dropping it like it’s hot. What the hell is going on here? You sin against Christ.

With all of this, not one Bishop, not one Deacon, not one Captain, officer or soldier had the nerve to say this don’t look right, hey Dallas that’s adultery, we shouldn’t be partying like this, it’s not a good look. Nobody said that. That is why we all have to take inventory of ourselves.

“Beware that thou be not deceived and brought down in thy jollity.” Sometimes you’re drinking, laughing, having a good time. Ain’t nothing wrong with that, but it will make you forget the scriptures at times, like ‘avoid all appearance of evil’ in 1 Thessalonians 5. It will make us forget that, so we always have to take inventory and check ourselves.
“Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.” It’s that quick. It’s a thin line between standing and falling.

Sisters, the Bible says “Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.” The foolish woman plucks it down with her hands. Why get married, sister, if your goal and objective is to take what the brother has? That is evil, that’s wicked as hell. I’m not advocating it, but there are videos of men losing their minds and coming back with a 9 millimeter, and now she’s running around pleading the blood of Jesus. No, you did some evil stuff.

We’ve seen it in IUIC. A brother and sister get married. He has a house already paid for, that he worked his whole life for. She brings her unbelieving grown daughters into the house, and the brother has to pay all the utilities and the food while they pay for nothing, don’t cook, don’t clean. He gets frustrated and shuts all the power off. He had put her name on the deed, so they get divorced and she gets half of all he has. Evil black women, some of them sitting in here. That is the wood and earth we were reading about, the vessels to dishonor. Everybody ain’t for your betterment.

There is also a mindset with some women: they want a baby but they don’t want that man attached to it, friends with benefits, get pregnant and go separate ways. Now in Israel some women come in with these feminist mentalities, looking around for who is handsome. She makes you think she wants a family, has the baby, and all of a sudden there’s fighting, and now you’re out the door. She got the baby; that’s all she wanted. That’s evil.

precepts.why:
You think the Lord don’t see? “The Spirit of Almighty God, which made all things, and searcheth out all hidden things in the secrets of the earth, Surely he knoweth your inventions, and what ye think in your hearts, even them that sin, and would hide their sin.” He sees what you think and what you invent in your heart, the scheme to take the brother’s house or to get the baby and put the man out.

“Therefore hath the Lord exactly searched out all your works, and he will put you all to shame. And when your sins are brought forth, ye shall be ashamed before men, and your own sins shall be your accusers in that day.” That’s for you adulterers and adulteresses walking around in IUIC like la la la. There is going to be a judgment for that. You are not going to get away with it. It is still adultery.

sense.text:
“In three things I was beautified, and stood up beautiful both before God and men: the unity of brethren, the love of neighbours, a man and a wife that agree together.” Brother, you and your wife should both agree once you got married. Why did you get married if y’all don’t agree? It makes no God-given sense; it’s just evil. If you committed fornication, stay out for two years, watch online, support online, and let the Lord deal with that. Why get married to somebody you don’t like, and she don’t like you? Some of you are in relationships like that.

A sister came who is married to a brother who don’t believe; he don’t come to the school. They had been together three years, and he has a son of 14. She looked through the son’s phone and found he had been talking to men he met online and meeting those men. She told her husband to wake up, his son is dealing with men, and he turned over and went to sleep. Did you call the cops? Not yet. There is all kind of criminality going on there, statutory rape, and nobody gives a damn. Where’s the police? That is a man and a wife that do not agree together.

“These are murmurers, complainers”. You have to be aware of the brothers and sisters around you who are murmurers. We only know what y’all allow us to see; y’all don’t show the grimy side. Everybody puts on their good-natured representative, and then I hear brothers are murmuring and complaining.

“Walking after their own lusts”: brothers and sisters that murmur and complain walk after their own desires, their own impulses. “And their mouth speaketh great swelling words”, like lies. “Having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage”: this is why they want to be near the captains, the deacons, the Bishops, near those who have some type of influence. Those type of advantages the Lord don’t look for. He don’t want that.

“Remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ; How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time”. Those men and women who don’t give a damn about the Bible, but they’re here, in the body, just here for an opportunity. They “walk after their own ungodly lusts”, whether it’s adultery or fornication. There is no fear of God; they don’t care. They are here to get what they can get from each and every one of you.

“These be they who separate themselves”: those spirits that murmur and complain are the ones that separate themselves. “Sensual”: they are emotional. “Having not the Spirit”: they don’t have the Holy Spirit, and we have to be able to pick up on men and women like that.

“He giveth power to the faint”. This goes back to those of us that faint in this truth. You might have stumbled; it’s okay, get back up, don’t stay down. If you’re going through battle fatigue, don’t give up. You’re struggling, striving, fighting: stay on your feet. “And to them that have no might he increaseth strength”: he will make sure the proper people are put around you.
“Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall”: that is those youth that are not in this truth.

“But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength”: if we wait upon the Lord, we shall renew our strength. “They shall mount up with wings as eagles”: there’s going to come a day in the coming kingdom when we are going to be able to fly. “They shall run, and not be weary”: we ain’t going to get tired. “And they shall walk, and not faint.”

We all want to get to that part, walking with the giants. But all the things just mentioned went on, and there is more not mentioned, and we still all want to get to this point.

“Keep silence before me, O islands”. God says shut the hell up, keep silent before me. O islands: you from the islands, Haiti, Santo Domingo, Puerto Rico, shut up. “And let the people renew their strength”.
“Who raised up the righteous man from the east”: verses two and three go into Cyrus, the Persian king.
“Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the Lord, the first, and with the last; I am he.”

“The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid”. They helped every one his neighbour and said to his brother “Be of good courage.” “So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith”: this is talking about idols. They built idols for protection and for strength, fastened “with nails, that it should not be moved.”

This is what all of it was leading to, after everything we talked about, brothers and sisters. “But thou, Israel, art my servant”: we are the servants of the one true God. “Jacob whom I have chosen”: we are the chosen. “The seed of Abraham my friend”: we are the seed of Abraham, who was God’s friend.
“I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.” God has chosen us, and God has not cast us away.

“Fear thou not”: God says to us don’t be afraid, don’t be scared. “For I am with thee”: God is with us, brothers and sisters. “Be not dismayed”: don’t be shocked. “I will strengthen thee”: so when you go through battle fatigue, don’t worry, God says he will strengthen you. “Yea, I will help thee”: just be patient. “I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness”: that’s Christ.

“Behold, all they that were incensed against thee”: all the nations that hated our guts, that scoffed and mocked us, “shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing”. These nations we see today shall be as nothing. “And they that strive with thee shall perish”: those nations that strive with us and fight against us shall perish. That’s what thus saith the Lord says.

“Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them”: we shall seek these nations and not find them, “even them that contended with thee”. “They that war against thee shall be as nothing”: the nations that war against us, like the dragon that made war with the woman.
“For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.” Don’t be scared, brothers; don’t be scared, sisters.

“Fear not, thou worm Jacob”. He calls us a worm. Yes, we are a worm: we suffer battle fatigue, we struggle with child molestation, adultery, the works of the flesh. We struggle and we fight. “And ye men of Israel; I will help thee”: if we struggle and fight, he said I will help thee, “saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.”

“Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth”: he is going to change us into celestial beings, gods on earth, deadly weapons on earth, if we wait for him, if we endure, if we strive and struggle and get back up on our feet. “Thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small”: we are going to thresh the governments on earth and beat them small; that’s what Christ said in Revelation. “And shalt make the hills as chaff”: we are going to make the small governments like nothing.

“Thou shalt fan them”: we are going to fan these governments, “and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the Lord, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.” All Israel shall rejoice in the Lord, and we are all going to glory in the Holy One of Israel.
